title: A dynamical approach to Schur's Theorem
summary: A classical result of Schur of 1904 shows that an abstract group with finite central quotient has finite derived subgroup. Schur's Theorem has many important consequences and generalizations, which have been extensively investigated in the literature. We develop a new dynamical interpretation of Schur's Theorem for locally compact groups, using the notion of topological entropy of Adler, Konheim and McAndrew.
